chunks: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was shrouded in three garments: two ẓafarī Yemeni cloaks and a garment of kursuf, which is a cotton cloth.

key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.ظَفِرِيَّتَيْنِ: two garments of the Ẓafārī Yemeni type
key_terms.كُرْسُفٍ: a cloth material identified here as cotton textile

ai.seo_question: How was the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم shrouded?
ai.summary: This hadith states how the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was shrouded after his passing. It identifies the number and type of garments used, making it relevant to funerary jurisprudence and the prophetic sunnah.
